projects.name: Haus TF
projects.briefDescription: Single‑family house (110 m² GIA, €1.1M) in the UNESCO‑protected Neusiedler See landscape, set between forest and vineyard. The design balances contemporary expression with vernacular character: untreated larch and locally sourced stone reinforce regional identity, while generous openings frame vineyard views and connect the interior to the landscape.
responsibilities: Led planning app (approved first pass), tender & construction packages
Produced technical drawings, construction details and coordinated drawing sets
Managed documentation: drawings, 3D model, specs, schedules, change logs
Liaised with client, consultants and trade contractors

projects.name: ‘OPUS’ Bar — Ivan Vazov
projects.briefDescription: Lightweight, reversible 557 m² steel canopy enabling year‑round use of a bar terrace in Sofia’s historic centre (~400 guests), with integrated lighting/sound and connections to existing utilities. A compact 5 m² bar wraps a masonry core (storage, WCs), while polycarbonate sliders and fabric curtains provide seasonal flexibility.
responsibilities: Prepared planning application package
Produced technical drawings, 3D model and renders
Liaised with structural engineer, fabricator and geotech

projects.name: Mühlbach 2023 (Ski Playground)
projects.briefDescription: A Kids’ Snow Park for learning and practicing skiing, with progressive training features, gentle slopes, rest areas, and viewpoints. A long ski bridge links the park to the main building—a commercial and transport hub. The park spans a small ravine, turning the ditch into a playful, accessible crossing.
responsibilities: Designed layout variations for studio director to approve
Prepared concept design presentation for client

projects.name: Horses for the Historic Carriage
projects.briefDescription: Presentation of the historic carriage, according to its function. Two abstract racehorses of brass and stainless steel create the impression of movement. The illusion of movement is created by reflections of the bent metal © d*a
responsibilities: Issued manufacturer-ready drawings; coordinated fabrication
Designed twin metal 'horse' sculptures; full 3D/2D models & drawings
Reconstructed 3D carriage model from photos and scant dimensions
Created renders and client packs

projects.name: Blue Porcelain Collection — Esterházy Castle
projects.briefDescription: Within the 13th-century castle treasury, blue porcelain hovers on gold-plated plinths cantilevered from structural glass fins delicately set in compacted sand. Restored wall paintings and limestone floors remain; gaps are stitched with brass inlay. Building services hide behind a gold-plated sculptural door, turning routine maintenance into a quiet, deliberate feature.
responsibilities: Converted point cloud of stone floor to clean, textured mesh
Built a 3D room model from survey drawings
Produced layout plan, 2D drawings, renders, client packs

projects.name: Highrise
projects.briefDescription: An urban research initiative testing compact high‑rise strategies to activate residual city lots. The project examines vertically stacked, flexible floor plates integrated with rainwater collection, open greening, climatic interaction, and material reuse from the outset. Research focused on three European cities and three typical constrained site typologies.
responsibilities: Developed diagrams, plans, visuals, 3D models & prototypes
Compiled research on rainwater, greening, climate systems
Contributed to studio research methodology

projects.name: C Plas
projects.briefDescription: Concept design for a semi-detached, two-family holiday house on a very steep Tyrolean alpine plot. Required garages and sports-gear storage for both units. Site steepness and height limits shaped the structure, turning constraints into advantages. Fully solar-powered, with a private terrace and garden for each household. Access, snow management considered.
responsibilities: Developed concept design together with studio director
Produced design variations
Created interior and exterior visualisations

projects.name: Pathway Over the Mountain
projects.briefDescription: Historic sidewalk stones, gravestones, and cuboids from St. Margarethen are reused to form a climb-assisting landscape linking parking to the ‘path over the mountain.’ Laser-scanned, 3D-modelled, and sorted into nine types, stones are arranged unchanged on an orthogonal grid aligned to route and parking, yielding paths and a legible topography.
responsibilities: Scan-to-strategy workflow: point-cloud capture → 3D modelling → typology sorting (9 types) → rule-based placement
Designed pathway network

projects.name: Silent Meditation Forest Cabin
projects.briefDescription: Single-occupancy cabin (max. 15m² GFA) prototype for an organic farm in Latvia. A compact plan maximizing space value; a split-level roof forms a semi-sheltered terrace. Inside, a continuous built-in surface becomes desk, bed, oven and storage, softly zoning a cork-lined meditation/yoga area. A material palette of thatch, cob, cork, and timber.
responsibilities: Produced concept package: plans, diagrams, visualisations and key details
Material-led design using vernacular materials: thatched roof, cob, timber and cork
Passive environmental strategies for comfort, durability and low-impact construction

projects.name: Monsieur George — Boutique Hotel
projects.briefDescription: Comprehensive refurbishment of a 5‑star boutique hotel near the Champs‑Élysées. Scope included 46 guestrooms across 6 floors, all public areas—courtyard, bar, restaurant, reception—and a new courtyard mezzanine apartment. Delivered as lead architects with Paris partners, including full FF&E; interiors by Anouska Hempel.
responsibilities: Developed 50+ bespoke FF&E shop drawings
Coordinated with specialists to finalise production details
Maintained FF&E schedule: makers, materials, dims, quantities
Assisted with technical drawings

projects.name: Ennismore Gardens
projects.briefDescription: Comprehensive refurbishment of a large private London mews house. Including granted permission for an extension.
responsibilities: Produced interior visualisations
Assisted with technical drawings
Prepared client presentations

projects.name: ShangriLA Hotel HK
projects.briefDescription: Luxury 5-star hotel in Hong Kong. Upper-tier rooms required integrated mini-kitchens, a challenge within already constrained footprints. Developed through schematic design with space-efficiency studies and layout options, but the project was not realized.
responsibilities: Assisted with technical drawings
Produced interior visualisations

projects.name: Private House Refurbishment
projects.briefDescription: Comprehensive house refurbishment in central Seville. Assisted with technical drawings, produced physical and 3D models, and conducted a site survey to verify existing dimensions and levels.
responsibilities: Assisted with technical drawings and renders
Produced physical and 3D models
Conducted a site survey to verify existing dimensions and levels

projects.name: Apple Marunouchi
projects.briefDescription: In Tokyo’s Marunouchi district beside Tokyo Station. The tower’s perimeter grid forms two-storey glass vitrines framed in specially cast aluminium with 3D-radiused corners. Inside, a double-height forum linked by a sculptural white-steel stair with terrazzo tread.
responsibilities: Assisted with technical drawings and BIM updates (MicroStation)
Built 1:50 working model; swappable floors & facade (laser-cut)
Produced 1:10 facade corner mock-up (CNC)
Attended multi-disciplinary project meetings

projects.name: Hilton Hotel
projects.briefDescription: Interior fit-out for Hilton Sofia, delivered as the interior contractor: carpets, bespoke furniture and wall claddings, wall coverings and curtains, architectural lighting, and full paintwork—procured, coordinated, and installed as a complete FF&E and finishes package.
responsibilities: Joined site visit to Hilton Hotel project in Sofia
Observed coordination of engineers, architects, contractors
Studied materials and textiles used for the project
